name: Elijah Mankutam Ali
title: Educator | Communicator | Civil Activist | Student Leader | Wikimedian| Poet|Graphic Designer
biography: Hon. Elijah Mankutam Ali is an educator, communicator, civil activist, student leader, and Wikimedian from the North East Region of Ghana. He is passionate about education, youth participation, responsible leadership, and community development. Through his academic journey, leadership appointments, teaching experience, Christian ministry, and community service, he seeks to empower young people and contribute meaningfully to the development of Ghana.
education: Enchi College of Education: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) in English Language, with Social Studies as a minor course; expected graduation in 2028. Nalerigu Senior High School: Senior high school education. Binde Junior High School: Junior high school education. Binde D/A Primary School: Primary education.
leadership:
1. Municipal Chief Executive, East Mamprusi, under the Youth Parliament of Ghana
2. Regional Representative, National Regional Representatives Council of Elders and Advisors, Youth Parliament of Ghana
3. Development Liaison Officer for Bunkpurugu Constituency, Youth Parliament of Ghana
4. Former student leader and course representative.
experience:
Private school teacher at Sunesis Vine Montessori Basic School, Nalerigu.

Sunday school teacher at House of Prayer Assemblies of God Church, Nalerigu. 

Student leadership and Wikimedia activities.
